doc:
### PROPOSAL-08 — Bauhaus / Geometric Modern - **slug**: `bauhaus` - **Vibe**: Primary color blocks, a strict grid, and Swiss typography — form follows function, boldly. - **Best for**: Analytics dashboards and dense tables where structure is the aesthetic. Adjectives: rigorous, timeless, confident. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#f4f4f0` | Off-white gallery canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card and panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#ecebe4` | Raised surfaces, hover fills | | `--border-subtle` | `#dedcd2` | Fine grid hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#b8b5a8` | Standard structural borders | | `--border-focus` | `#0033a0` | Bauhaus-blue focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#141414` | Near-black headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#44423c` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6f6c62` | Captions, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#e63225` | Bauhaus-red primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#c92a1e` | Action hover (deeper red) | | `--color-earnings` | `#9a7b00` | Darkened bauhaus-yellow earnings (AA-safe) | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#7f6600` | Earnings hover (deeper olive-gold) | | `--color-automation` | `#0033a0` | Bauhaus-blue automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#d08a00` | Amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#a1121f` | Deep-red destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(230, 50, 37, 0.12)` | Red tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(154, 123, 0, 0.12)` | Gold tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(0, 51, 160, 0.12)` | Blue tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` at 700-800 weight, tight tracking; KPI numerals use heavy weights and `tabular-nums`. Sans: `"Inter", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"Space Mono", ui-monospace, monospace`. Micro-labels are uppercase with `letter-spacing: 0.12em` — pure Swiss grid discipline. - **Radii & Borders**: Sharp corners — `border-radius: 0` everywhere. 1px borders on structure; 2px rules used as deliberate geometric accents (section dividers, top strips). No shadows; hierarchy comes from contrast and geometry. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Square corners. Primary = solid red block with white text (bold, AA-large). Secondary = white fill with 2px ink border. Tertiary = text-only with a trailing arrow. Focus = 2px blue outline with a 2px gap. Hover = background flips to a 2px block under the label. - **Cards**: White with a 1px border and an optional 4px geometric strip on top (red, yellow, or blue). No shadows, no rounding — pure blocks. - **Badges/Status**: Square chips, uppercase, with a tiny square status dot. Publishing = red square pulsing; published = blue square. No pills. - **Tables**: Strict grid with 1px rules and generous tabular numerals; header row is uppercase micro-type. Row hover = 2px left rule in the section color. - **Forms/Inputs**: Square fields with only a 2px bottom rule; focus = 2px blue bottom rule. Labels sit above in uppercase micro-type. - **Loading**: Indeterminate = red/yellow/blue segments cycling left-to-right; determinate = a straight, square progress bar filling in 1px steps. - **Signature detail**: The primary-color geometric motif (red square, yellow circle, blue triangle) used as section markers and empty-state art, plus heavy uppercase Swiss type — unmistakably Bauhaus. - **Motion & Animation**: Crisp and instant — 80ms linear; Turbo Stream inserts use a geometric wipe (clip-path sweep from left) rather than fade. Nothing lingers; state changes snap like a press. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
AUTOMATED POSTS 128
```
